SELECT 'cal' AS k, fiscal_period_label AS a, CAST(period_start_date AS VARCHAR) AS b, CAST(period_end_date AS VARCHAR) AS c, CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR) AS d FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period IN (3,4,5)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fmt', format, CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT store_id) AS VARCHAR), CAST(min(store_id) AS VARCHAR) FROM dim_store GROUP BY format
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dupe', 'lines', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS VARCHAR) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.store_key, s.store_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND s.store_id<900
)
SELECT 'multi_store_receipts' AS k, CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) AS v FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM base GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT store_id)>1 OR count(DISTINCT sale_date)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'store999_lines', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM base WHERE store_id=999
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff_lines', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM base WHERE staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'ZZ_lines', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM base WHERE category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'mixed_staff_receipts', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM base GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_or_zero_lines', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM base WHERE net_amount<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'stores_multi_format', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT format)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stores_in_p4_cur_format_differs', CAST(count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS VARCHAR) FROM base b JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=b.store_key JOIN dim_store c ON c.store_id=s.store_id AND c.is_current WHERE s.format<>c.format

calls.statement:
SELECT cs.format AS store_format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id < 900
UNION ALL

FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id < 900
